title: The Morning Light Is Breaking
description: The Morning Light Is Breaking in Tonic Solfa to GREENLAND, doh is Eb: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 3 verses and a piano.
about: Samuel Francis Smith wrote these words. They were printed in the Evangelical Lutheran Hymn-Book (St. Louis, 1927), as hymn 471.

The book printed the words without tunes, marked Sevens and Sixes Double (7.6.7.6.7.6.7.6), to be sung to any tune of that metre. This page sets them to GREENLAND; any other Sevens and Sixes Double tune fits them as well.
underlay: The morn-ing light is break-ing; The dark-ness dis-ap-pears; The sons of earth are wa-king To pen-i-ten-tial tears; Each breeze that sweeps the o-cean Brings ti-dings from a-far Of na-tions in com-mo-tion, Pre-pared for Zi-on’s war.

lines: The sons of earth are waking
Each breeze that sweeps the ocean
Stay not till all the lowly
Stay not till all the holy

licence: Public domain: Samuel Francis Smith died in 1895.
credits: Words by Samuel Francis Smith (1808–1895), public domain, as printed in the Evangelical Lutheran Hymn-Book (1927); set to GREENLAND by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
